rTMR_Variance_Sensor3 := 0.98 * rTMR_Variance_Sensor3 + 0.02 * (rTemp_Core_TMR3 - rVoted_CoreTemp_DegC) * (rTemp_Core_TMR3 - rVoted_CoreTemp_DegC);

(* Excessive noise variance threshold check (> 0.08 deg C^2 indicates lead degradation or loose terminal) *)
IF rTMR_Variance_Sensor1 > 0.08 THEN
    wAlarm_Word_3 := wAlarm_Word_3 OR 16#0020; (* Sensor 1 high noise variance *)
END_IF;
IF rTMR_Variance_Sensor2 > 0.08 THEN
    wAlarm_Word_3 := wAlarm_Word_3 OR 16#0040; (* Sensor 2 high noise variance *)
END_IF;
IF rTMR_Variance_Sensor3 > 0.08 THEN
    wAlarm_Word_3 := wAlarm_Word_3 OR 16#0080; (* Sensor 3 high noise variance *)
END_IF;

(* Sensor physical bounds sanity checking (-20.0 deg C to +35.0 deg C) *)
IF rTemp_Core_TMR1 < -20.0 OR rTemp_Core_TMR1 > 35.0 THEN
    bTMR_Sensor1_Fault := TRUE;
    wAlarm_Word_3 := wAlarm_Word_3 OR 16#0001; (* Sensor 1 out of physical bounds *)
END_IF;

IF rTemp_Core_TMR2 < -20.0 OR rTemp_Core_TMR2 > 35.0 THEN
    bTMR_Sensor2_Fault := TRUE;
    wAlarm_Word_3 := wAlarm_Word_3 OR 16#0002; (* Sensor 2 out of physical bounds *)
END_IF;

IF rTemp_Core_TMR3 < -20.0 OR rTemp_Core_TMR3 > 35.0 THEN
    bTMR_Sensor3_Fault := TRUE;
    wAlarm_Word_3 := wAlarm_Word_3 OR 16#0004; (* Sensor 3 out of physical bounds *)
END_IF;

(* 2oo3 Discrepancy Debounce Timers (Threshold = 0.85 deg C for > 150 ms) *)
IF rTMR_Delta12 > 0.85 AND rTMR_Delta31 > 0.85 THEN
    rTMR_Discrepancy_Timer1 := rTMR_Discrepancy_Timer1 + rDeltaTime_Scan;
    IF rTMR_Discrepancy_Timer1 > 0.150 THEN
        bTMR_Sensor1_Fault := TRUE;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rTMR_Discrepancy_Timer1 := 0.0;
END_IF;

IF rTMR_Delta12 > 0.85 AND rTMR_Delta23 > 0.85 THEN
    rTMR_Discrepancy_Timer2 := rTMR_Discrepancy_Timer2 + rDeltaTime_Scan;
    IF rTMR_Discrepancy_Timer2 > 0.150 THEN
        bTMR_Sensor2_Fault := TRUE;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rTMR_Discrepancy_Timer2 := 0.0;
END_IF;

IF rTMR_Delta23 > 0.85 AND rTMR_Delta31 > 0.85 THEN
    rTMR_Discrepancy_Timer3 := rTMR_Discrepancy_Timer3 + rDeltaTime_Scan;
    IF rTMR_Discrepancy_Timer3 > 0.150 THEN
        bTMR_Sensor3_Fault := TRUE;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rTMR_Discrepancy_Timer3 := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Fault Reset Logic *)
IF bAcknowledgeFaults THEN
    IF rTMR_Delta12 <= 0.85 OR rTMR_Delta31 <= 0.85 THEN
        bTMR_Sensor1_Fault := FALSE;
    END_IF;
    IF rTMR_Delta12 <= 0.85 OR rTMR_Delta23 <= 0.85 THEN
        bTMR_Sensor2_Fault := FALSE;
    END_IF;
    IF rTMR_Delta23 <= 0.85 OR rTMR_Delta31 <= 0.85 THEN
        bTMR_Sensor3_Fault := FALSE;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Count surviving healthy channels *)
iTMR_HealthyCount := 3;
IF bTMR_Sensor1_Fault THEN
    iTMR_HealthyCount := iTMR_HealthyCount - 1;
    wAlarm_Word_1 := wAlarm_Word_1 OR 16#0001; (* Bit 0: Core TMR Sensor 1 Fault *)
END_IF;
IF bTMR_Sensor2_Fault THEN
    iTMR_HealthyCount := iTMR_HealthyCount - 1;
    wAlarm_Word_1 := wAlarm_Word_1 OR 16#0002; (* Bit 1: Core TMR Sensor 2 Fault *)
END_IF;
IF bTMR_Sensor3_Fault THEN
    iTMR_HealthyCount := iTMR_HealthyCount - 1;
    wAlarm_Word_1 := wAlarm_Word_1 OR 16#0004; (* Bit 2: Core TMR Sensor 3 Fault *)
END_IF;

(* Synthesize Voted Process Core Temperature with Multi-Tier Degradation *)
IF iTMR_HealthyCount = 3 THEN
    (* Fully nominal 2oo3 Median Selection *)
    IF (rTemp_Core_TMR1 <= rTemp_Core_TMR2 AND rTemp_Core_TMR2 <= rTemp_Core_TMR3) OR
       (rTemp_Core_TMR3 <= rTemp_Core_TMR2 AND rTemp_Core_TMR2 <= rTemp_Core_TMR1) THEN
        rVoted_CoreTemp_DegC := rTemp_Core_TMR2;
    ELSIF (rTemp_Core_TMR2 <= rTemp_Core_TMR1 AND rTemp_Core_TMR1 <= rTemp_Core_TMR3) OR
          (rTemp_Core_TMR3 <= rTemp_Core_TMR1 AND rTemp_Core_TMR1 <= rTemp_Core_TMR2) THEN
        rVoted_CoreTemp_DegC := rTemp_Core_TMR1;
    ELSE
        rVoted_CoreTemp_DegC := rTemp_Core_TMR3;
    END_IF;
    bDegradedMode_Active := FALSE;
ELSIF iTMR_HealthyCount = 2 THEN
    (* Degraded 1oo2 Mean Averaging of Remaining Healthy Pair *)
    bDegradedMode_Active := TRUE;
    IF bTMR_Sensor1_Fault THEN
        rVoted_CoreTemp_DegC := 0.5 * (rTemp_Core_TMR2 + rTemp_Core_TMR3);
    ELSIF bTMR_Sensor2_Fault THEN
        rVoted_CoreTemp_DegC := 0.5 * (rTemp_Core_TMR1 + rTemp_Core_TMR3);
    ELSE
        rVoted_CoreTemp_DegC := 0.5 * (rTemp_Core_TMR1 + rTemp_Core_TMR2);
    END_IF;
ELSIF iTMR_HealthyCount = 1 THEN
    (* Critical 1oo1 Operation: Fallback to Single Surviving Sensor *)
    bDegradedMode_Active := TRUE;
    wAlarm_Word_1 := wAlarm_Word_1 OR 16#0008; (* Bit 3: Critical loss of TMR redundancy *)
    IF NOT bTMR_Sensor1_Fault THEN
        rVoted_CoreTemp_DegC := rTemp_Core_TMR1;
    ELSIF NOT bTMR_Sensor2_Fault THEN
        rVoted_CoreTemp_DegC := rTemp_Core_TMR2;
    ELSE
        rVoted_CoreTemp_DegC := rTemp_Core_TMR3;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    (* Total Sensor Blindness: Immediate Failsafe SIL-3 Trip *)
    wAlarm_Word_1 := wAlarm_Word_1 OR 16#0008;
    bQuenchTriggerLatched := TRUE;
    iFaultHistoryRegister := 101; (* Tripped: All 3 core thermocouples lost *)
    rVoted_CoreTemp_DegC := 25.0; (* Failsafe high forced value *)
END_IF;

(* =================================================================================================== *)
(* 2. IN-LINE ATR-FTIR RESIDUAL DIAZONIUM & SPECTROSCOPIC CONVERSION TRACKING                          *)
(* =================================================================================================== *)
(* Check spectrometer signal-to-noise ratio *)
IF rFTIR_SignalNoiseRatio < 20.0 THEN
    wAlarm_Word_3 := wAlarm_Word_3 OR 16#0010; (* Optical SNR degraded *)
END_IF;

(* Multi-point baseline corrected peak absorbances *)
rFTIR_Peak_Diazonium_Corr := rFTIR_Absorbance_Diazonium - rFTIR_Absorbance_Baseline;
IF rFTIR_Peak_Diazonium_Corr < 0.0 THEN
    rFTIR_Peak_Diazonium_Corr := 0.0;
END_IF;

rFTIR_Peak_Amine_Corr := rFTIR_Absorbance_Amine - rFTIR_Absorbance_Baseline;
IF rFTIR_Peak_Amine_Corr < 0.0 THEN
    rFTIR_Peak_Amine_Corr := 0.0;
END_IF;

rFTIR_Peak_Azo_Corr := rFTIR_Absorbance_AzoCoupling - rFTIR_Absorbance_Baseline;
IF rFTIR_Peak_Azo_Corr < 0.0 THEN
    rFTIR_Peak_Azo_Corr := 0.0;
END_IF;

rFTIR_Peak_Nitrous_Corr := rFTIR_Absorbance_NitrousAcid - rFTIR_Absorbance_Baseline;
IF rFTIR_Peak_Nitrous_Corr < 0.0 THEN
    rFTIR_Peak_Nitrous_Corr := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Check side-product diazoamino formation (indicates insufficient acid or temperature hot spots) *)
IF rFTIR_Peak_Azo_Corr > 45.0 THEN
    wAlarm_Word_2 := wAlarm_Word_2 OR 16#0020; (* Diazoamino side product accumulation *)
END_IF;

(* Excess nitrous acid accumulation check *)
IF rFTIR_Peak_Nitrous_Corr > 85.0 THEN
    wAlarm_Word_2 := wAlarm_Word_2 OR 16#0100; (* Excess unreacted nitrous acid *)
END_IF;

(* Dynamic fractional chemical conversion of aromatic amine precursor *)
IF rInitial_Amine_Absorbance > 1.0 THEN
    rConversion_Amine_Pct := (1.0 - (rFTIR_Peak_Amine_Corr / rInitial_Amine_Absorbance)) * 100.0;
    IF rConversion_Amine_Pct > 100.0 THEN
        rConversion_Amine_Pct := 100.0;
    ELSIF rConversion_Amine_Pct < 0.0 THEN
        rConversion_Amine_Pct := 0.0;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rConversion_Amine_Pct := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Diazonium risk accumulation index: 0.0 (safe nominal) to 1.0 (dangerous accumulation) *)
(* Calibration: 650 mAU corresponds to critical concentration of 1.80 mol/L in flow cell *)
rResidual_Diazonium_Index := rFTIR_Peak_Diazonium_Corr / 650.0;
IF rResidual_Diazonium_Index > 1.0 THEN
    rResidual_Diazonium_Index := 1.0;
    wAlarm_Word_2 := wAlarm_Word_2 OR 16#0004; (* Bit 2: Diazonium accumulation risk high *)
END_IF;

(* Incomplete conversion alarm in steady-state production *)
IF rConversion_Amine_Pct < 91.5 AND iState = 40 THEN
    wAlarm_Word_2 := wAlarm_Word_2 OR 16#0008; (* Bit 3: Conversion efficiency below spec *)
END_IF;

(* =================================================================================================== *)
(* 3. CALORIMETRIC DYNAMIC RUNAWAY HEAT FLUX TRACKING & SEMENOV CRITERION                             *)
(* =================================================================================================== *)
(* First and second numerical derivatives of voted core temperature with Butterworth low-pass filter *)
rdT_dt_Filtered := 0.82 * rdT_dt_Filtered + 0.18 * ((rVoted_CoreTemp_DegC - rPrev_VotedTemp) / rDeltaTime_Scan);
rd2T_dt2_Filtered := 0.82 * rd2T_dt2_Filtered + 0.18 * ((rdT_dt_Filtered - rPrev_dT_dt) / rDeltaTime_Scan);
rPrev_VotedTemp := rVoted_CoreTemp_DegC;
rPrev_dT_dt := rdT_dt_Filtered;

(* Coolant jacket dynamic heat extraction: Q_cool = rho * V_dot * Cp * (T_out - T_in) *)
(* Syltherm XLT density * Cp at -15 deg C = 888 kg/m3 * 1552 J/(kg*K) = 1.378 J/(mL*K) *)
rHeat_CoolantJacket_W := (rFlow_Coolant_Jacket / 60.0) * 1.378 * (rTemp_Coolant_JacketOut - rTemp_Coolant_JacketIn);

(* Reactor thermal capacitance accumulation: Q_accum = C_reactor * dT/dt *)
(* Microreactor Hastelloy C-276 / Silicon block thermal capacitance = 46.2 J/K *)
rHeat_ThermalMass_Accum_W := 46.2 * rdT_dt_Filtered;

(* Total instantaneous chemical reaction heat generation [W] *)
rTotal_Heat_Generated_W := rHeat_CoolantJacket_W + rHeat_ThermalMass_Accum_W - rCalorimetric_Baseline_W;
IF rTotal_Heat_Generated_W < 0.0 THEN
    rTotal_Heat_Generated_W := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Rolling buffer averaging over 10 scans for heat flux smoothing *)
rHeatFlux_Buffer[iHeatFlux_BufIdx] := rTotal_Heat_Generated_W;
iHeatFlux_BufIdx := iHeatFlux_BufIdx + 1;
IF iHeatFlux_BufIdx > 10 THEN
    iHeatFlux_BufIdx := 1;
END_IF;

rHeatFlux_MovingAvg_W := 0.0;
FOR iIterRow := 1 TO 10 DO
    rHeatFlux_MovingAvg_W := rHeatFlux_MovingAvg_W + rHeatFlux_Buffer[iIterRow];
END_FOR;
rEstimated_HeatFlux_W := rHeatFlux_MovingAvg_W * 0.10;

(* Overall heat transfer conductance UA estimation *)
(* Log-Mean Temperature Difference calculation with series expansion protection *)
rTempSum := (rVoted_CoreTemp_DegC - rTemp_Coolant_JacketIn);
rTempGradVal := (rVoted_CoreTemp_DegC - rTemp_Coolant_JacketOut);
IF rTempSum > 0.1 AND rTempGradVal > 0.1 AND ABS(rTempSum - rTempGradVal) > 0.05 THEN
    rLocalLogArg := rTempSum / rTempGradVal;
    (* First-order logarithmic series approximation: ln(z) ~ 2*(z-1)/(z+1) *)
    rLMTD_DeltaT := (rTempSum - rTempGradVal) / (2.0 * (rLocalLogArg - 1.0) / (rLocalLogArg + 1.0));
ELSE
    rLMTD_DeltaT := 0.5 * (rTempSum + rTempGradVal);
END_IF;
IF rLMTD_DeltaT < 0.5 THEN
    rLMTD_DeltaT := 0.5;
END_IF;
rOverall_HeatTransfer_UA := rHeat_CoolantJacket_W / rLMTD_DeltaT;

(* Dimensionless Semenov Runaway Criterion: Psi = (Ea / (R * T^2)) * (Q_gen / (UA)) *)
rAbsoluteTemp_Kelvin := rVoted_CoreTemp_DegC + 273.15;
IF rOverall_HeatTransfer_UA > 0.1 AND rAbsoluteTemp_Kelvin > 200.0 THEN
    rSemenov_Runaway_Number := (rApparent_Activation_Energy / (rGasConstant_R * rAbsoluteTemp_Kelvin * rAbsoluteTemp_Kelvin)) * (rEstimated_HeatFlux_W / rOverall_HeatTransfer_UA);
ELSE
    rSemenov_Runaway_Number := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Hydrodynamic Microchannel Transport Calculations *)
rTotalVolumetricFlow_mLmin := rFlow_AmineFeed_Coriolis + rFlow_NitriteAcid_Coriolis;
(* Cross-sectional area = 0.45 mm x 0.45 mm = 2.025E-7 m2 *)
IF rTotalVolumetricFlow_mLmin > 0.05 THEN
    rMicrochannel_Velocity_ms := (rTotalVolumetricFlow_mLmin * 1.0E-6 / 60.0) / 2.025E-7;
    rReynolds_Number_Fluid := (rFluid_Mean_Density * rMicrochannel_Velocity_ms * 0.00045) / rFluid_Dynamic_Viscosity;
    rPrandtl_Number := (rFluid_Dynamic_Viscosity * 3650.0) / rFluid_Thermal_Conductivity;
    rGraetz_Number := (0.00045 / 0.125) * rReynolds_Number_Fluid * rPrandtl_Number;
    (* Sieder-Tate laminar microchannel correlation for square ducts *)
    rNusselt_Number_HeatTransfer := 3.66 + (0.0668 * rGraetz_Number) / (1.0 + 0.04 * (rGraetz_Number * 0.6667));
ELSE
    rMicrochannel_Velocity_ms := 0.0;
    rReynolds_Number_Fluid := 0.0;
    rNusselt_Number_HeatTransfer := 3.66;
END_IF;

(* Microchannel Hydraulic Resistance Monitoring (Detection of Salt Precipitation / Clogging) *)
IF rTotalVolumetricFlow_mLmin > 0.5 THEN
    rMicrochannel_Hydraulic_Res := (0.5 * (rPress_Inlet_Amine + rPress_Inlet_Nitrite) - rPress_Reactor_Outlet) / rTotalVolumetricFlow_mLmin;
    IF rMicrochannel_Hydraulic_Res > (rMicrochannel_Hydraulic_Base * 1.45) AND iState = 40 THEN
        bMicrochannel_Clogging_Alert := TRUE;
        wAlarm_Word_2 := wAlarm_Word_2 OR 16#0200; (* Microchannel hydraulic fouling alert *)
    ELSE
        bMicrochannel_Clogging_Alert := FALSE;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rMicrochannel_Hydraulic_Res := rMicrochannel_Hydraulic_Base;
    bMicrochannel_Clogging_Alert := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* Exothermic Runaway Detection Criteria *)
IF (rd2T_dt2_Filtered > 1.10 AND rdT_dt_Filtered > 0.40 AND rVoted_CoreTemp_DegC > 1.2) OR (rSemenov_Runaway_Number > 0.36) THEN
    wAlarm_Word_1 := wAlarm_Word_1 OR 16#0040; (* Bit 6: Heat flux runaway acceleration alert *)
    bRunawayMitigation_Engaged := TRUE;
    IF rVoted_CoreTemp_DegC > 3.6 OR rdT_dt_Filtered > 1.25 THEN
        wAlarm_Word_1 := wAlarm_Word_1 OR 16#0080; (* Bit 7: Critical thermal runaway trip *)
        bQuenchTriggerLatched := TRUE;
        iFaultHistoryRegister := 102; (* Critical runaway breach *)
    END_IF;
ELSE
    bRunawayMitigation_Engaged := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* Absolute Core Temperature Envelope Boundaries [-10.0 deg C to +5.0 deg C] *)
IF rVoted_CoreTemp_DegC > 2.5 THEN
    wAlarm_Word_1 := wAlarm_Word_1 OR 16#0010; (* Bit 4: Core temperature high warning *)
END_IF;
IF rVoted_CoreTemp_DegC > 5.0 THEN
    wAlarm_Word_1 := wAlarm_Word_1 OR 16#0020; (* Bit 5: Critical high temp ceiling trip (+5.0 deg C) *)
    bQuenchTriggerLatched := TRUE;
    iFaultHistoryRegister := 103; (* Max core temperature limit breached *)
END_IF;

(* =================================================================================================== *)
(* 4. DUAL CORIOLIS MICRO-PUMP STOICHIOMETRIC MODULATION & LEAD-LAG SYNCHRONIZATION                 *)
(* =================================================================================================== *)
(* Coriolis density degassing verification (detection of N2 micro-bubbles from early decomposition) *)
IF (rDensity_Amine_Coriolis < 0.930 AND rDensity_Amine_Coriolis > 0.100) OR
   (rDensity_Nitrite_Coriolis < 1.075 AND rDensity_Nitrite_Coriolis > 0.100) OR
   (rDriveGain_Amine_Coriolis > 72.0) OR (rDriveGain_Nitrite_Coriolis > 72.0) THEN
    wAlarm_Word_1 := wAlarm_Word_1 OR 16#4000; (* Bit 14: Coriolis degassing / micro-bubbles detected *)
END_IF;

(* Density-based dynamic viscosity compensation factors *)
IF rDensity_Amine_Coriolis > 0.50 THEN
    rAmine_Viscosity_Comp := rAmine_Density_Nominal / rDensity_Amine_Coriolis;
ELSE
    rAmine_Viscosity_Comp := 1.0;
END_IF;

IF rDensity_Nitrite_Coriolis > 0.50 THEN
    rNitrite_Viscosity_Comp := rNitrite_Density_Nominal / rDensity_Nitrite_Coriolis;
ELSE
    rNitrite_Viscosity_Comp := 1.0;
END_IF;

(* Convert Coriolis volumetric flow rates to molar feed rates *)
(* Amine Precursor stock: 1.85 mol/L active amine *)
(* Nitrite/Acid mixture stock: 2.10 mol/L active HNO2 *)
rMolarFlow_Amine := (rFlow_AmineFeed_Coriolis / 1000.0) * 1.85 * rAmine_Viscosity_Comp;     (* mol/min *)
rMolarFlow_Nitrite := (rFlow_NitriteAcid_Coriolis / 1000.0) * 2.10 * rNitrite_Viscosity_Comp; (* mol/min *)

IF rMolarFlow_Amine > 0.0001 THEN
    rCurrent_StoichRatio := rMolarFlow_Nitrite / rMolarFlow_Amine;
ELSE
    rCurrent_StoichRatio := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Check Stoichiometric Balance (Nominal Range: 1.04 to 1.18 mol/mol) *)
IF (rCurrent_StoichRatio < 1.03 OR rCurrent_StoichRatio > 1.22) AND iState = 40 THEN
    wAlarm_Word_2 := wAlarm_Word_2 OR 16#0001; (* Bit 0: Stoichiometric ratio deviation alert *)
END_IF;

(* First-Order Lead-Lag Dynamic Compensator on Amine Pump Master Demand *)
(* Compensates for the transport delay in the split-and-recombine micro-mixer *)
rLeadLag_State := rLeadLag_State + (rDeltaTime_Scan / 2.20) * (aActuatorU[3] - rLeadLag_State);

(* Stoichiometric Fine-Trim Integrator with Anti-Reset Windup Clamping *)
IF iState = 40 THEN
    rRatio_Integrator := rRatio_Integrator + 0.075 * (rRatio_AcidAmine_Target - rCurrent_StoichRatio) * rDeltaTime_Scan;
    IF rRatio_Integrator > rRatio_Integral_Limit THEN
        rRatio_Integrator := rRatio_Integral_Limit;
    ELSIF rRatio_Integrator < -rRatio_Integral_Limit THEN
        rRatio_Integrator := -rRatio_Integral_Limit;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rRatio_Integrator := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* =================================================================================================== *)
(* 5. DISCRETE STATE-SPACE LUENBERGER OBSERVER EXECUTION                                              *)
(* =================================================================================================== *)
(* Pack physical measurements into measurement vector y *)
aMeasY[1] := rVoted_CoreTemp_DegC;
aMeasY[2] := rFTIR_Peak_Diazonium_Corr;

(* Innovation Error Vector Calculation: e_y = y - C * x_pred *)
FOR iIterRow := 1 TO 2 DO
    rTempSum := 0.0;
    FOR iIterCol := 1 TO 4 DO
        rTempSum := rTempSum + aMatC[iIterRow, iIterCol] * aStateX_Pred[iIterCol];
    END_FOR;
    aInnovY[iIterRow] := aMeasY[iIterRow] - rTempSum;
END_FOR;

(* Check observer innovation divergence *)
IF ABS(aInnovY[1]) > 4.50 THEN
    wAlarm_Word_3 := wAlarm_Word_3 OR 16#0400; (* State-space observer thermal divergence *)
END_IF;

(* State Estimation Correction Step: x_hat = x_pred + L * e_y *)
FOR iIterRow := 1 TO 4 DO
    rTempSum := 0.0;
    FOR iIterCol := 1 TO 2 DO
        rTempSum := rTempSum + aMatL[iIterRow, iIterCol] * aInnovY[iIterCol];
    END_FOR;
    aStateX_Hat[iIterRow] := aStateX_Pred[iIterRow] + rTempSum;
END_FOR;

(* State Time Propagation / Prediction Step: x_pred(k+1) = A * x_hat + B * u *)
FOR iIterRow := 1 TO 4 DO
    rTempSum := 0.0;
    FOR iIterCol := 1 TO 4 DO
        rTempSum := rTempSum + aMatA[iIterRow, iIterCol] * aStateX_Hat[iIterCol];
    END_FOR;
    FOR iIterCol := 1 TO 3 DO
        rTempSum := rTempSum + aMatB[iIterRow, iIterCol] * (aActuatorU[iIterCol] / 100.0);
    END_FOR;
    aStateX_Pred[iIterRow] := rTempSum;
END_FOR;

(* =================================================================================================== *)
(* 6. MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC) CONDENSED QUADRATIC COST APPROXIMATION                           *)
(* =================================================================================================== *)
(* Linear Gradient Vector: g = G^T * Q * (F * x_hat - TargetRef) *)
aGrad_g[1] := rMPCTrackingWeight_Temp * (aStateX_Hat[1] - rCoreTemp_Setpoint_Target) + rMPCEffortWeight_Move * aDeltaU_Prev[1];
aGrad_g[2] := rMPCTrackingWeight_Conc * (aStateX_Hat[3] - rDiazConcSetpoint) + 1.25 * (aStateX_Hat[1] - rCoreTemp_Setpoint_Target);
aGrad_g[3] := -0.85 * (aStateX_Hat[4] - 0.05) - 0.40 * (aStateX_Hat[1] - rCoreTemp_Setpoint_Target);

(* Projected Gradient Iterations for Optimal Control Move DeltaU *)
FOR iQPIterCount := 1 TO 3 DO
    FOR iIterRow := 1 TO 3 DO
        rTempGradVal := aGrad_g[iIterRow];
        FOR iIterCol := 1 TO 3 DO
            rTempGradVal := rTempGradVal + aHessian_H[iIterRow, iIterCol] * aDeltaU[iIterCol];
        END_FOR;
        aDeltaU[iIterRow] := aDeltaU[iIterRow] - rQP_LearningRate * rTempGradVal;
        (* Enforce slew rate constraints (-2.5% to +2.5% per 10 ms cycle) *)
        IF aDeltaU[iIterRow] > 2.50 THEN
            aDeltaU[iIterRow] := 2.50;
        ELSIF aDeltaU[iIterRow] < -2.50 THEN
            aDeltaU[iIterRow] := -2.50;
        END_IF;
    END_FOR;
END_FOR;

(* Real-time quadratic performance cost metric: J = 0.5 * DeltaU^T * H * DeltaU + g^T * DeltaU *)
rMPC_Cost_Function_J := 0.0;
FOR iIterRow := 1 TO 3 DO
    rMPC_Cost_Function_J := rMPC_Cost_Function_J + aGrad_g[iIterRow] * aDeltaU[iIterRow];
    FOR iIterCol := 1 TO 3 DO
        rMPC_Cost_Function_J := rMPC_Cost_Function_J + 0.5 * aDeltaU[iIterRow] * aHessian_H[iIterRow, iIterCol] * aDeltaU[iIterCol];
    END_FOR;
END_FOR;
aDeltaU_Prev := aDeltaU;

(* =================================================================================================== *)
(* 7. HYDRAULIC PRESSURE INTEGRITY & HARDWIRED SAFETY INTERLOCK SUPERVISION                           *)
(* =================================================================================================== *)
IF NOT bSafetyInterlockOk THEN
    wAlarm_Word_1 := wAlarm_Word_1 OR 16#0800; (* Bit 11: Safety interlock loop broken *)
    bQuenchTriggerLatched := TRUE;
    iFaultHistoryRegister := 104; (* Safety interlock loop open *)
END_IF;

IF bManualQuenchTrigger THEN
    wAlarm_Word_1 := wAlarm_Word_1 OR 16#1000; (* Bit 12: Manual quench push button activated *)
    bQuenchTriggerLatched := TRUE;
    iFaultHistoryRegister := 105; (* Operator manual emergency push button *)
END_IF;
